notes.title: Updates 5 and 6
notes.content:
New Interstitial/cinematic for intro sequence.
New Interstitial/cinematic sequence when retrieving the Howling Stone from the Sages.
New Esher Stone Art.
New Gameplay area - Loguer's Sil
-This area is now loaded with enemies and significantly harder.

Added inventory numerical stats/damage values for: 
-Killing Power (main hand weapon, off hand weapon, dash)
-Spell - Ranged
-Spell - Area of Effect

Hover your mouse over the stats for updated damage values. These will be tuned throughout EA.

Dash and melee damage values increased for most classes. 

Some small updates to Mon Don Tor which will be receiving the majority of Art, Performance and gameplay updates in the coming weeks.

notes.title: Update 4
notes.content:
In this update we added interstitial (cinematic) events when transitioning to new areas. This will help explain some of the robust story that was previously missing.

Also added a visual counter of the Angel Statues aka Lore Angels - interacting with an Angel Statue will trigger VO and story events.

Also in this update are fixes to some projectiles, improved Art and enemy spawns in the Corrupted Moor and several bug fixes.

notes.title: Update 3
notes.content:
-2 new playable classes: Berserker and Engraver!

The Berserker is a heavy duty melee fighter with the heart of the primal god within him. 
The Engraver is a Warlock-like caster with a variety of powerful spells at their disposal.

Also in this update:
-Descriptions added to inventory items.
-Fixed a couple of critical issues.


More to come:
-3 additional classes; Ruiner, Saint and Sprite.
-Performance
-Improved Art and revised layout designs to the Overgrothe and many dungeons.

notes.title: Update 2
notes.content:
Set 'esc' key as default to open menu
Added HUD popup when in range of an interact - key defaults to E/interact.
Fixed a potential critical issue where player character would be unable to enter the Scarlet Vault after retrieving the Howling Stone from the Stone Sage Sanctifier.

More updates to come - Thanks!

notes.title: Quick Bug Fix Patch
notes.content: Fixed a handful of issues. Larger update to come next week.
